_about: Prompts for Egg karaoke (js/karaoke.js), generated with the ElevenLabs Sound Effects API by tools/gen-sounds.js --manifest tools/karaoke.json, then chosen, pitched and levelled by tools/pick-karaoke.js into sounds/karaoke/. inst = one note of each band instrument (the app pitches it to every note of the song); sing = the short syllable each friend sings the tune with (a cartoon hum for the friends that make no call of their own: turtle, mole, snail, axolotl, ladybug); extra = each friend's second sound, its ad-lib in the gaps. Every one has a synthesised fallback.
common: close-up, isolated, no music, no speech, no background noise
commonInst: one single isolated note, dry studio recording, no reverb, no other instruments, no melody
